ClimberBlock.description: Why a climber is [`blocked`](ClimberStatus::Blocked), each reason naming its fix.

oneOf.description:
The combination cannot be launched at all, and nothing of its rung is in flight.
Fix: fix the cause, then retry the climber, which resolves it again.

reason.description: Why, in the words the launch pass reports it with.

oneOf.description:
A job the dispatch launched for the rung slot used up its automatic retries
without a counted run, no later launch of the dispatch took its place, and
nothing of the slot is in flight. Fix: fix the
cause, then retry the climber (`POST /ladders/{id}/climbers/retry`), which
relaunches it.

attempts.description: How many attempts that launch made: the first, and each automatic retry.

oneOf.description:
Every run the rung will get has completed and the rung is still undecided,
because `runs` of them carry no validator rating (pushed while the backend did
not hold the case version). Fix: re-push the runs, or stop the dispatch.

runs.description: How many of the rung's counted runs carry no validator rating.

ClimberStatus.description:
Where one climber of a dispatch stands.

There is no "waiting on a review" state: the validators rate every completed run, so
a rung the dispatch can still feed is `running`, and one nothing it does can move is
`blocked`, with the reason in [`LadderClimber::blocked`].

oneOf.description: The current rung is undecided and its runs can still launch.

The current rung is undecided and nothing the dispatch does will move it. Why,
and what fixes it, is [`LadderClimber::blocked`].

The current rung was failed. The validators are assumed correct, so this is the
climber's result.
Every rung passed. There is nothing left to climb.

DispatchRuns.description:
How much of a dispatch's execution is behind it: the figures its progress bar is
drawn from.

done.description:
The runs that need no more executing, summed per slot: a passed, failed or
skipped slot's whole target less the runs the dispatch still has in flight for
it, a running or blocked slot's runs, and nothing of a pending one. A run that
existed before the dispatch started is done from its first pass. Equal to
`total` once nothing is left to execute.

inFlight.description:
The jobs the dispatch launched that are still in flight (`queued` through
`running`).

total.description: The sum over rung slots of the rung's target runs.

DispatchStatus.description:
Where a ladder's latest dispatch stands. A ladder never run has no dispatch, which
the console reads as "Not run yet".

oneOf.description: Launch passes are still climbing it.

It is running and waiting on its owner: none of its jobs is in flight, every
climber is completed, failed or blocked, and at least one is blocked. A reading of
a running dispatch, derived whenever its status is reported and never stored: a
climber's Retry or a run arriving for one of its slots makes it `running` again.
Every climber completed or failed and none of its runs is in flight.
Its owner stopped it. It launches nothing more.

Gate.description:
The rule one ladder applies at every rung.

Stored per ladder (not per rung): a ladder is a single question asked of an
ordered series of cases, so the bar it sets is the ladder's, and a rung only
varies how many runs it takes to answer.

earlyStop.description:
Whether the gate may decide on partial results, the caller then cancelling the
slot's jobs that have not started yet. **Off** by default — the runs are evidence in
their own right, so a rung finishes what it started even when the verdict is
already certain.

floor.description:
The worst rating that still counts as clearing the rung. A run rated this
or better passes; anything worse does not.

unloadedCountsAsBroken.description:
Whether a run whose build never loaded counts as [`Rating::Broken`] outright,
whatever its validator rating says. On by default: there was nothing to play.

GateThreshold.description:
How many of a rung's runs must clear the [floor](Gate::floor) for the climber to
pass the rung.

oneOf.description:
An absolute number of runs, independent of how many the rung ran. `1` is
"any run clearing the floor is enough", which is how "stop only when
everything is broken" is expressed.

runs.description: The number of runs that must clear the floor.

oneOf.description:
A share of the runs the rung finishes with, compared as
`count >= fraction * runs`. Values outside `0.0..=1.0` are clamped into
it, and a non-finite value (which cannot come from valid JSON but can from a
corrupt row) reads as `0.0`.

Clamping is not the same as neutralising: below the range it degrades to
"always pass", but above it degrades to `1.0`, the strictest bar the rule
can express — every run must clear the floor. That is deliberate.
A fraction over one is a typo, not an instruction, and the nearest expressible
reading of "more than all of them" is "all of them"; inventing a permissive
answer instead would let a mistyped gate wave every climber through.

fraction.description: The share of the rung's runs that must clear the floor.

InFlightLimit.description:
How many of a plan's or a ladder dispatch's own jobs may be in flight at once before a
launch pass stops emitting — or no bound at all.

The unbounded shape is its own variant rather than a large bound so that it is
stored, reported, and shown as the instruction it is, and so that no bound the owner
types can be mistaken for it.

oneOf.description:
Keep at most `runs` jobs in flight. `0` is a legitimate bound — "launch nothing"
— and is not the same instruction as no bound.

runs.description: The most jobs that may be in flight before a launch pass stops.

oneOf.description:
No bound: a launch pass emits every missing cell it can. The per-cell target and
the harness parallelism cap still apply.

LadderAxis.description:
Which axis a ladder's emission loop nests on — and therefore the order its runs
execute in, by the same mechanism a plan's axis works: emission order is queue
order is execution order.

oneOf.description:
Bring every climber up one rung before anyone moves on — the board advances
as a row. The default: it is what makes a ladder comparable across models.

Take one climber as far up as it gets before starting the next — the board
advances as a column. Answers "how far does *this* model get?" soonest.

LadderClimber.description: One climber of a dispatch and its whole standing.

blocked.description: Why the climber is blocked, naming the fix, or null when it is not.

currentRung.description: The position of the rung it stands on (or failed), absent once it completed.

ggConfigId.description: The gg configuration this climber runs (`saved:<id>`), or null on a harness climber.

ggConfigName.description: That configuration's current display name, or null on a harness climber.

ggSlotModels.description:
The model bound to each of the configuration's launch slots, keyed by slot name.
Empty on a harness climber.

harness.description: The harness the climber runs — `gg` on a gg climber.

key.description:
The combination's canonical key — the text the dispatch records this climber's
state against.

Its shape follows the shape of the combination: a harness climber's key is its
`harness|model|provider` triple, and a gg climber's names the configuration and the
models it binds, because two climbers running one configuration on different models
are exactly the two arms a ladder exists to separate. It is written and compared,
never parsed.

model.description:
The model the climber's runs are attributed to: the harness climber's own, and for a
gg climber the model its bound configuration's root agent runs.

provider.description: The provider for a provider-routed harness, or null.

slots.description: One slot per rung of the dispatch, in rung order.

unlaunchable.description: Why this climber cannot be launched at all, or null when it can.

LadderDispatch.description: A ladder's latest dispatch, as its board reports it.

climbersCompleted.description: How many climbers passed every rung.

climbersFailed.description: How many climbers failed a rung.

endedAt.description: RFC 3339 of when it finished or was stopped, absent while running.

gate.description: The gate, as it stood at Run.

id.description: The dispatch's id: the second segment of its jobs' origins.

inFlightLimit.description: The runs-in-flight limit resolved at Run.

outerAxis.description: The climb order, as it stood at Run.

retryCount.description:
The retry limit, as it stood at Run: how many automatic retries each run the
dispatch launches gets.

runs.description: The runs: total, done, in flight.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 of the Run that started it.

LadderProgressRung.description:
One rung as the progress board describes it: the declaration plus how its pin has
aged.

engine.description:
The engine to climb on, or null for the `none` engine.

Part of the rung's identity within the climb, because clearing a case with a
runtime underneath is a different achievement from clearing it with nothing: one
ladder holds the same case at the same version and variant twice when the two
pins name different engines.

id.description:
The rung's **stable opaque id**, minted when the rung is added and never
reused.

Emphatically not its position. Rungs get reordered and re-pinned, and every
recorded verdict references this id — a positional identifier would silently
reattribute a climber's verdicts to a different case the moment the ladder was
rearranged.

latestVersion.description: The newest ingested version of this case. Empty when the case is not ingested.

position.description: Its position in the climb, from zero.

runs.description:
This rung's override of the ladder's runs-per-cell target, or null to inherit
it — so one pivotal step can demand more evidence without making the whole
climb more expensive.

stale.description: Whether the pinned version is not the newest ingested one.

LadderSlot.description: One rung slot of one climber.

decidedAt.description:
RFC 3339 of when the gate decided the slot, on a passed or failed slot. A verdict
a read computed live, which the next launch pass records, carries the read's time.

jobIds.description:
The jobs the dispatch launched for this slot that are still in flight, in queue
order. The tally's `inFlight` also counts a job of the cell someone else
launched, so it can exceed these.

position.description: The rung's position in the climb, from zero.

runIds.description:
The slot's runs, oldest first: the first runs of its cell to finish, up to the
rung's target, whoever launched them. Empty on a slot the climber has not
reached.

rungId.description: Which rung, by its stable id.

tally.description:
The gate evidence behind the slot's answer: present on a slot that has been
reached or has runs.

RungTally.description:
The counts one gate answer was made from, so a dashboard can say *why* a slot passed,
failed, or is still running without re-deriving the floor and unloaded-run rules.

The wire mirror of [`GateTally`], which is an internal type of the pure core.

counted.description: The slot's counted runs: finished runs that are the model's result.

inFlight.description: The slot's jobs still in flight.

passing.description: Rated runs rated at or above the gate's floor.

pending.description: Runs the slot will still finish with: `max(target, counted + inFlight) − counted`.

rated.description:
Counted runs the gate has a rating for — carrying a validator rating, or
decided as broken because the build never loaded or the model failed.

required.description:
How many passing runs the threshold demands, as the whole number of runs it
actually takes — a fractional bar of 2.5 means three.

unrated.description: Counted runs with no validator rating.

SlotCounts.description: How many of a dispatch's rung slots are in each [`SlotStatus`].

SlotStatus.description: Where one **rung slot** — one climber on one rung of a dispatch — stands.

oneOf.description: The climber's current rung, undecided, with runs launched or waiting for room.
The climber's current rung, undecided and blocked.
The gate passed it.
The gate failed it.
Not reached yet, while the dispatch is running.
Never to run: the climber failed an earlier rung, or the dispatch was stopped.

description: The ladder's board: the rungs, its latest dispatch, and every climber of it.

climbers.description: Every climber of the dispatch, in its resolved order. Empty without one.

dispatch.description: The latest dispatch, or null for a ladder never run.

rungs.description:
The rungs, low to high: the dispatch's when there is one, else the
configuration's.

runsUnreviewed.description:
The completed runs among the dispatch's slots' runs that the requester has not
reviewed — exactly what `GET /ladders/{id}/queue` offers. Information only.
